evidence.correctness: Oracle: CEN's EN16931-UBL-validation.xslt (validation-1.3.17 release zip from ConnectingEurope/eInvoicing-EN16931) under SaxonC-HE (pip saxonche), plus Python decimal ROUND_HALF_UP. 8 generated UBL invoices (gen.py from examples/ubl-invoice.xml): correct IDR 12,345,678,901.23 at 11% (the prior high defect), correct IDR 9,876,543,210,987.65 at 11%, half-cent ties 1.50x19% and 26.75x10%, a breakdown tax 0.01, 0.90 and 1.50 off, a buyer with endpoint but no BT-46. Built-in route (report.mjs preflightDocuments): no finding on the 5 correct files, warning INV-038 on the 0.01/0.90 files (CEN passes), blocking INV-038+INV-018 on the 1.50 file (CEN fails BR-CO-17, BR-S-09): 8 of 8 agree with CEN. Official route adds only XRechnung BR-DE-* (the files declare XRechnung). Python CLI: same verdicts on all 8. repairUbl on the 10^10 IDR file: unchanged (prior defect closed). repairUbl on the 10^13 IDR file before the fix: gross and due rewritten 10962962964196.29 -> .30, CEN then fails BR-CO-15 (new low defect, fixed in this PR; CEN passes the repaired file after). VAT: 3,000 numbers over 20 EU countries vs python-stdnum 2.x: 2,963 agree, 37 differ, all in the documented deliberate list (CZ/SK birth-number months and SK third digit strict, BG 10-digit and ES X lenient, DE leading 0; README:73, :1749). Capped at 3 because the repair defect existed on arrival.
evidence.completeness: Every prior defect re-checked (prior_defects). Exercised end to end: UBL reader + built-in checks, official Schematron route, repairUbl, Python CLI, VAT check digits, eval/page-cli-parity.mjs, served copy (served-copy.mjs: clean). Documented open gaps: NO/CH VAT and PDF envelope checks absent from the Python CLI (NEXT.md:33). No stubs met.
evidence.verification: `node --test` in the subject with slimdom@4.3.5/fontoxpath@3.34.0 installed as CI does: 2400 tests, 2383 pass, 0 fail, 17 skip (35.8 s) on arrival; 2403/2386/0/17 after this PR. Python: `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 447 OK. CI (.github/workflows/einvoice-preflight-ci.yml:87) now installs both packages before `node --test`, so the official-route tests run (prior defect 4 closed). Five mutants via quality_mutate.py, all caught: BG EGN remainder-10 -> 1 and CZ 10-digit `% 10` dropped (both survived in the prior audit), checks.mjs tie precision 15 -> 12, BR-CO-17 tolerance `< 100` -> `<= 100`, repair fmt without the tie fix. Gap: no test had an amount of 10^13 or more (added in this PR).
evidence.craft: Read checks.mjs:1-60,110-126, breakdown.mjs:20-140, repair-ubl.mjs:36-60,425-460, vat.mjs:180-226,1013-1030, CI workflow. The same rounding idiom is still pasted in checks, breakdown, adjustment, linenet (identical) plus variants in creditlink and repair-ubl x2; this PR had to patch four copies to fix one defect. Per-line VAT rounding now warns instead of blocking (the prior first-hour gap), a buyer identified by VAT id, legal id or endpoint no longer draws INV-005, and Indonesian-scale amounts check and repair correctly up to 10^13 after this PR. Remaining: CLI users lack NO/CH VAT and PDF checks.

Remaining departure: INV-005 still blocks a buyer known by name alone, where BT-46/47/48 are optional in EN 16931; documented as deliberate (README:1165, checks.mjs:114-117). VAT algorithms agree with stdnum outside the documented list.

verdict: Fifth audit, first to meet the bar. Fix PRs #17724, #18913, #18785 and #19757 closed five of the eight 2026-11-19 defects, the high one included. On 8 generated invoices the built-in route, the official route and the Python CLI all agree with CEN's own EN 16931 Schematron 1.3.17 run under SaxonC: the 10^10 IDR invoice is clean, per-line rounding under one unit warns, a full unit off blocks. All 5 seeded mutants fail the suite, including the two remainder-10 mutants that survived twice before, and CI now runs the official-route tests. VAT check digits agree with python-stdnum on 2,963 of 3,000 numbers, and the 37 differences are documented. One new defect on arrival: from 10^13 units the repair still damaged a correct invoice (gross off by a cent, then rejected by CEN). It is fixed in this PR with a test, but scores are before the fix, so correctness stays 3. Craft stays 2: the rounding helper is copied seven times and the README is a 398 KB log. NO/CH VAT is still missing from the Python CLI, and a name-only buyer still draws a stricter-than-EN-16931 INV-005.
